# SetHero

> > Film production management software and templates for call sheets, scheduling, and production documentation.

SetHero provides professional film production tools including call sheet generation, production templates, and integration with industry-standard software like Movie Magic Scheduling, Excel, StudioBinder, and Celtx. The platform serves independent filmmakers, film schools, and production teams with SAG-AFTRA compliant documentation and workflow solutions.

## Key Topics

- Call Sheets
- Production Management
- Movie Magic Scheduling
- Excel Templates
- SAG-AFTRA Compliance
- Production Reports
- Film Crew Management
- Legal Release Forms
- StudioBinder
- Celtx
- Film Production Software
- American Film Market (AFM)
- Film Incentives
- Filmmaker Salaries
- Production Documentation
